summary: Bank7 Corp. filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing that Century Financial Services Corporation shareholders approved the September 16, 2026 merger agreement under which Century will merge into Bank7. Bank7 also received approval or non-objection from the Federal Reserve Board and the New Mexico Financial Institutions Division. Closing is expected on or about November 1, 2026, subject to remaining conditions. No price, exchange ratio, premium, or advisor is stated. What to watch: satisfaction of residual closing conditions and whether the November 1 target holds.
